senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="P01016">same</cite> <cite ref="Menachot 41a:13">Men. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>עַנְשִׁיתוּ אעשה</he> do you (in heaven) punish a sin of omission? <he>בזמן דאיכא ריתחא עַנְשִׁינָן</he> when there is a time of divine anger, we do punish.

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 63a">Erub. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>ואי׳ רבי וכ׳</he> and R. Elazar … was punished (came to grief).
<cite ref="Eruvin 63a">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>אפ״ה אי׳</he> nevertheless he came to grief (was degraded).

<cite ref="Sukkah 51b:8">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>מ״ט אִיעַנְּשׁוּ</he> why were they punished (to suffer execution under Hadrian)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 43b:9">Snh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>ועד השתא מ״ט לא אִיעֲנוּשׁ</he> and up to that time why were they (the Israelites) not punished (for Achan’s misdeeds)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 44a:1">Ib. 44ᵃ</cite> top <he>עכן מ״ט איענוש</he> (supply <cite ref="P00794"><he>עליה</he></cite>) why were they punished for Achan’s (undiscovered) sin?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 18:5">Yalk. Josh. 18</cite> <he>עכן מ״ט איענש</he> why was Achan’s sin visited (upon the people)? <cite ref="Beitzah 16a:11">Bets. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>לא לִיעַנְּשׁוּ וכ׳</he> (not <he>לע׳</he>) let gentiles not be punished for neglecting it; a. fr.
